resources.string: HorizonCam needs camera access to work. Microphone is used for video sound.

Your video stays level, even if you turn the phone all the way round.
• Tap the running-figure icon (top left) to choose Steady or Steady + horizon lock. • The frame button (bottom left) records landscape while you hold the phone upright, or portrait while you hold it sideways. • Tap the four dots (bottom right) for quick controls: torch, timer, ratio, video size, brightness, grid and settings.
Gestures • Tap to focus, then drag up or down to change the brightness. Long-press locks focus and exposure. • Swipe left or right to change mode. Swipe up or down to switch cameras. • Drag sideways on the zoom buttons, or pinch, to zoom. • While recording: pause, and take photos from the video. • Volume keys take a photo or start recording.
